2610.06571.title: BrainTRACE: Tracing Longitudinal, Multimodal, and Volumetric Evidence in Brain MRI Clinical Reasoning
2610.06571.paper_summary: Brain MRI interpretation is a longitudinal clinical reasoning problem: radiologists compare serial studies, integrate information across MRI sequences, localize findings within volumetric anatomy, and translate this evidence into report-grounded assessments. Existing medical VQA and 3D imaging benchmarks capture important parts of this workflow, but often evaluate brain MRI through isolated images, static volumes, or ungrounded report-style answers, thereby obscuring failures in the evidence chain that support clinical validity. We introduce BrainTRACE, a report-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models can trace the evidence structure required for longitudinal brain MRI interpretation. BrainTRACE contains 7,273 scored VQA instances derived from 1,778 longitudinal patients, 7,299 MRI studies, and approximately 29k co-registered 3D MRI sequence volumes. The benchmark is organized by five levels of clinical reasoning, from acquisition recognition to case-level synthesis, and by evidence demands covering longitudinal comparison, report-grounded references, multi-sequence integration, and volumetric spatial evidence. BrainTRACE supports rendered inputs compatible with standard VLM interfaces, a 3D-evidence condition, and a decomposed case-reasoning track that audits six steps in a longitudinal evidence chain. Evaluation of 20 VLM configurations shows that current systems can identify isolated visual cues but rarely compose them into grounded longitudinal interpretations. We release the benchmark specification, evaluation lists, scoring implementation, scoring rubrics, and audit-record format to support reproducible progress in brain MRI VLM evaluation.
2610.06571.paper_summary_zh: 腦部MRI解讀是一個縱向臨床推理問題：放射科醫生比較連續的研究，整合MRI序列中的信息，在體積解剖中定位發現，並將這些證據轉化為基於報告的評估。現有的醫學VQA和3D影像基準捕捉了這一工作流程的重要部分，但通常通過孤立的圖像、靜態體積或無根據的報告風格答案來評估腦部MRI，從而掩蓋了支持臨床有效性的證據鏈中的失敗。我們引入了BrainTRACE，一個基於報告的基準，用於評估視覺-語言模型是否能夠追蹤縱向腦部MRI解讀所需的證據結構。BrainTRACE包含來自1,778名縱向患者、7,299個MRI研究和約29k個共同註冊的3D MRI序列體積的7,273個得分VQA實例。該基準按五個臨床推理層級組織，從獲取識別到案例級綜合，並按證據需求涵蓋縱向比較、基於報告的參考、多序列整合和體積空間證據。BrainTRACE支持與標準VLM接口兼容的渲染輸入、一個3D證據條件，以及一個分解的案例推理軌跡，審核縱向證據鏈中的六個步驟。對20個VLM配置的評估顯示，當前系統可以識別孤立的視覺線索，但很少將其組合成有根據的縱向解釋。我們發布基準規範、評估列表、得分實現、得分標準和審計記錄格式，以支持腦部MRI VLM評估的可重複進展。
